integrity: The rank diagram follows from a direct four-character plus two-dimensional Fourier-block proof. Sixty-four exact witnesses, transported to all 255 supports, were separately checked by exact eight-by-eight regular-convolution matrices. No external mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the eight-element quaternion group and arbitrary complex coefficients.
Rank-weighted convolution spectra, not singular-value magnitudes, conditioning, real or positive coefficients.
The general uncertainty bound, the Q8 Fourier transform, and some rank-two special cases are prior art.
Unindexed equivalent quaternion-convolution classifications could affect historical priority.
title: Complete antipodal-occupancy Fourier-rank spectrum on \(Q_8\)
